newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arthuis-France conditionally supports lira in ERM.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis-France conditionally supports lira in ERM.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Friday that France would support the Italian lira's return to Europe's exchange rate mechanism as soon as possible providing that appropriate terms could be agreed.

"The French government hopes that this will be done as soon as possible, assuming that the situation justifies it, that the Italian authorities want it and that we can fix a parity that is equitable, durable and sustainable," he told journalists.
Asked if the lira would be able to return to the Exchange Rate Mechanism this weekend he said, "I don't know. It depends on what sort of request is made and what answer is given."
In an interview with Reuters Financial Televison, Arthuis was asked if the lira was fairly valued at around 1,000 to the mark.
He replied by saying the topic would be discussed if Italy requested it.
